description:
Polypo connects your Polypo account to ChatGPT so shopping questions are answered with your own body instead of generic assumptions.

See it on you — send a product link or a photo of a garment and Polypo renders you actually wearing it, shown as an image in the conversation. It works from a link, from a photo on your device, or on one of Polypo's house models if you would rather not use a photo of yourself. It can wear a top and a bottom together, a whole outfit as it comes, or just the piece you asked for, and stack accessories on top — a bag, a belt, a scarf, sunglasses, several at once, each placed the way you say — and you choose which of your photos it is rendered on.

Get the size right — paste a brand's size chart, or drop in a screenshot of one, and Polypo works out which size fits: your measurements against the garment's on every dimension the brand lists, and how the other sizes scored. It remembers what it told you, so "what size am I in Zara" has an answer next time, and you can say how something actually fitted.

Your measurements — your stored girths and lengths in centimetres, from your Polypo avatar, whenever you want to check them.

Your wardrobe — garments you have sent or tried on are kept, so wearing one again is a tap rather than another upload, and your past try-ons stay where you can find them.

Sign in with your Polypo account. If you do not have an avatar yet, signing in walks you through creating one — that is where your measurements and your photos come from.

Privacy and control: Polypo only ever reaches the account you sign in with, over an OAuth-protected connection, and cannot see anyone else's data. It renders you on your own photos — there is no way to look up or render another person. The photos you send, the garments you keep, the sizes you were given and the renders themselves are stored on your Polypo account, and you can remove a photo, a garment or a try-on from the conversation at any time; your profile, avatar and measurements are managed at customer.polypo.io. Rendering a try-on, and reading a size chart out of a screenshot, are carried out by Google Cloud (Vertex AI) as our processor. Images are served over links that expire.

defaultPrompt: let me tryon this cool shirt i found
